newsitem.title: USA: American Pacific says delay affects Q1 revs.
newsitem.headline: American Pacific says delay affects Q1 revs.

text.p: American Pacific Corp said Wednesday operating results for its first fiscal quarter of 1997 will be "adversely affected" by a shipment delay.

The company said the delayed shipment, now complete, will result in a decrease of revenues of $2.4 million for the first quarter, but it will report increased revenues in the second quarter by the same amount.

The company said the ammonium perchlorate shipment was manufactured during the first quarter and ready to be shipped on schedule in late December, but "owing to direction received from the customer," the shipment was delayed to early January.
American Pacific said it will issue the results of its first fiscal quarter operations ended December 31, 1996 in February.
